INSERT INTO hr_interview_notifications(candidate_id,interview_type,event_id,kind,recipient,period)
SELECT s.candidate_id,s.interview_type,s.event_id,'feedback_reminder',reviewer.email,(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date
FROM hr_interview_sessions s JOIN candidates c ON c.id=s.candidate_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(s.reviewer_emails) AS reviewer(email)
WHERE s.candidate_id=$1 AND s.interview_type=$2 AND s.event_id=$3 AND c.stage=$2::text||'_scheduled'
AND CASE $2::text WHEN 'recruiter' THEN c.recruiter_event_id WHEN 'technical' THEN c.technical_event_id WHEN 'final' THEN c.final_event_id END=$3
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hr_interview_feedback f WHERE f.candidate_id=s.candidate_id AND f.interview_type=s.interview_type AND f.event_id=s.event_id AND f.reviewer_email=reviewer.email)
ON CONFLICT(candidate_id,interview_type,event_id,kind,recipient,period) DO NOTHING RETURNING id

WITH due AS (SELECT id FROM hr_interview_notifications WHERE status IN ('pending','processing') AND next_attempt_at<=now() ORDER BY next_attempt_at,id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS (
UPDATE hr_interview_notifications n SET status='processing',attempts=attempts+1,next_attempt_at=now()+interval '5 minutes' FROM due WHERE n.id=due.id RETURNING n.*)
SELECT n.*,s.reviewer_emails,c.name,c.role,c.stage,c.email AS candidate_email,c.hiring_manager_email,
CASE n.interview_type WHEN 'recruiter' THEN c.recruiter_event_id WHEN 'technical' THEN c.technical_event_id WHEN 'final' THEN c.final_event_id END AS current_event_id,
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hr_interview_feedback f WHERE f.candidate_id=n.candidate_id AND f.interview_type=n.interview_type AND f.event_id=n.event_id AND f.reviewer_email=n.recipient) AS has_feedback
FROM claimed n JOIN candidates c ON c.id=n.candidate_id JOIN hr_interview_sessions s ON s.candidate_id=n.candidate_id AND s.interview_type=n.interview_type AND s.event_id=n.event_id
UPDATE hr_interview_notifications SET status='sent',delivered_at=now(),last_error=NULL WHERE id=$1 AND attempts=$2 AND status='processing' RETURNING id
UPDATE hr_interview_notifications SET status='pending',last_error='DELIVERY_FAILED',next_attempt_at=now()+interval '5 minutes' WHERE id=$1 AND attempts=$2 AND status='processing' RETURNING id
UPDATE hr_interview_notifications SET status=$3,last_error=$4,next_attempt_at=now()+interval '5 minutes' WHERE id=$1 AND attempts=$2 AND status='processing' RETURNING id
